description: Optimize /prd efficiency with SkillOpt: test whether an optimized .agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md cuts the held-out mean cost for each plan by 20% or more with claude-opus-5-5, while the verify-prd.sh grounding guard holds.

userStories.title: Select the corpus and the split
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want a reproducible corpus of 32 closed issues in two splits so that the held-out split measures generalization.
acceptanceCriteria: `select.sh` writes `corpus/manifest.json` with the selection rule, the full candidate pool, each excluded candidate with its reason, and the `sha256` digest of each issue body.
The manifest holds 32 cases: 20 train cases and 12 held-out cases. Each area with 2 or more cases and at least 1 case outside the #1188 screen has at least 1 case in each split.
No held-out case is one of the 10 cases of the #1188 screen.
`tests/select-reproducible.sh` runs `select.sh` twice and exits 0 when the two manifests are equal.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: select.sh ran in the worker (exit 0); the manifest holds the rule, 56 pool entries with 11 excluded entries and their reasons, and 32 body digests. 2 executed: jq on the manifest gives 32 cases, 20 train and 12 held-out; each area with a case outside the screen and 2 or more cases has cases in both splits; .agro/hooks is train-only under the operator amendment. 3 executed: jq gives 0 screen cases in held-out. 4 executed: bash tests/select-reproducible.sh, exit 0, rerun by the advisor.

userStories.title: Run isolated episodes with an arm and repeats
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want an isolated episode runner for each arm so that no episode can read a later answer or reach GitHub.
acceptanceCriteria: `run-episode.sh <case-id> --run-id <id> --arm <baseline|candidate> --repeat <n>` builds the episode repository with `git-conventions/make-episode-repo.sh` and runs `claude` inside `git-conventions/no-egress.sh` with `--disallowedTools WebFetch WebSearch`.

The baseline arm overlays `.agro/skills/prd/` from the base revision. The candidate arm also replaces `SKILL.md` with the file at `--arm-rev candidate=<rev>`. The runner marks each overlay file skip-worktree.
Each record holds `usage.total_cost_usd`, `usage.num_turns`, `elapsed_s`, the verifier result, and `substance`: the `g1` checked-path count and the acceptance-criterion count of the plan.
`run-batch.sh` refuses to start an episode when the recorded cost of the run plus $1.50 exceeds the phase cap in `experiment.json`, and it runs at most 3 episodes in parallel.
`tests/run-episode.sh` runs the runner with a fake `claude` for each arm and exits 0. A fault injection with a shared-ref worktree makes the test exit 1.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: bash tests/run-episode.sh on the integrated task branch, exit 0; the fake claude saw the WebFetch WebSearch block, one commit, no refs, no remote, and no token. 2 executed: same run; the baseline skill_revision equals the base tree, the candidate SKILL.md differs, and SKILL.md is skip-worktree; untracked tracker.md goes to core.excludesFile. 3 executed: the example record holds usage, elapsed_s, verifier, and substance. 4 executed: same run; the phase cap refuses at $15.01, the first-episode gate stops at $3.50, and --jobs 4 exits 2; the reserve is stricter than the criterion: $1.50 for each running episode. 5 executed: fault injection with PRD_EFFICIENCY_REPO_BUILDER=tests/fixtures/shared-ref-repo.sh, exit 1. Frozen folders and lib/ unchanged (git diff --stat empty). Repair b72c34e6: the budget-guard check reads the noise cap from experiment.json; bash tests/run-episode.sh exit 0 and the shared-ref fault exit 1, rerun by the advisor on the integrated task branch.

userStories.title: Summarize cost, guard, and noise
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want one summary tool for the decision metrics so that each verdict is reproducible without new spend.
acceptanceCriteria: `summarize.sh <run-id>` writes `summary.json` with the mean cost, turns, and elapsed time for each arm, the pass rate and check rates for each arm, and the median substance for each arm.
`summarize.sh <run-id> --paired` writes the paired mean cost ratio of the candidate to the baseline and its 95% bootstrap interval with a fixed seed.

`summarize.sh <run-id> --noise` writes the within-issue standard deviation of the log cost and the minimum detectable cost ratio for each repeat count from 1 to 4, at a two-sided 0.05 level and a power of 0.80.
`tests/summarize.sh` exits 0 on fixture records with known means, a known ratio, and a known interval.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: bash tests/summarize.sh on the integrated task branch, exit 0 (27 checks); per-arm means, rates, and median substance match hand values. 2 executed: same run; --paired gives the geometric-mean ratio 0.584804, interval [0.5, 0.8] with seed 1197, byte-identical on rerun. 3 executed: same run; --noise gives sigma_w 0.309839 and minimum detectable ratios 0.7016, 0.7783, 0.8150, 0.8376 for 1 to 4 repeats at 12 cases. 4 executed: exit 0; four broken copies through PRD_EFFICIENCY_SUMMARIZE each exit 1 on the intended check. tests/run-episode.sh still exits 0. Frozen folders and lib/ unchanged.

userStories.title: Run the noise screen
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want a baseline-against-baseline measurement before the freeze so that the success threshold is larger than the run-to-run noise.
acceptanceCriteria: The first episode costs $3.00 or less before any other episode starts.
`runs/noise/` holds 15 records: 5 train cases, 3 repeats each, baseline arm.
`noise.md` reports the within-issue standard deviation of the log cost and the minimum detectable cost ratio for 12 held-out cases at 1 to 4 repeats.

`noise.md` names the held-out repeat count: the smallest count with a minimum detectable ratio of 0.80 or more. If no count from 1 to 4 meets that bound, the story stops the experiment and asks the operator.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: run-batch.sh --run-id noise --cases 1181 --repeats 1 --phase noise; the first episode cost $0.81, gate passed. 2 executed: jq on runs/noise/episodes.jsonl gives 15 ok baseline records, 5 cases x 3 repeats; total $12.26 under the $18 noise cap. 3 executed: summarize.sh noise --noise; sigma_w 0.068, minimum detectable ratios 0.925, 0.947, 0.956, 0.962 for 1 to 4 repeats at 12 cases; noise.md reports them. 4 executed: noise.md names 1 repeat under the rule; the advisor proposes the D1 held-out repeat count for operator approval at US-005 because the pass-rate guard needs more attempts than the cost metric.

userStories.title: Freeze D1
userStories.description: As the operator, I want every experiment value pinned before the baseline run so that no value changes after the model sees the data.
acceptanceCriteria: `experiment.json` records the model, the effort, the claude arguments, the prompt, the splits, the repeats, the phase caps, the hard cap, and the decision rule of issue #1197.

`check-pins.sh` exits 0 and pins the digests of `prd-grounding/verify-prd.sh`, `git-conventions/make-episode-repo.sh`, `git-conventions/no-egress.sh`, `lib/episode.sh`, the `/prd` skill tree, and `corpus/manifest.json`.
The operator approved the D1 values in a comment on issue #1197.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: jq on experiment.json shows model, effort, claude_args, prompt, splits 20/12, repeats 3/2/1/3, phase caps, hard cap 300, and the decision object read by summarize.sh. 2 executed: bash check-pins.sh on the integrated task branch, exit 0, 7 pins and 32 issue bodies; bash tests/pin-check.sh exit 0 with a fault for each pin. 3 reasoned: the operator approved the D1 values in this session on 2026-09-26; the advisor recorded them in issue comment 5848279579. Known gap: tests/run-episode.sh still asserts the old $15 noise cap after the advisor raised it to $18 in 4300e49e; a bounded repair of the US-002 test follows.

userStories.title: Adapt SkillOpt to an efficiency score
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want the SkillOpt adapter of #1171 to score efficiency under the guard so that the optimizer cuts cost safely.
acceptanceCriteria: For each train case, `hard` is 1 only when the latest episode passes `verify-prd.sh` and its cost is 0.80 or less of the baseline-train median cost of that case.

Each row for the proposer holds the plan, the verifier result, the cost, the turns, and a condensed tool trace: one line for each tool call with the tool name, the first 120 characters of the input, and the turn number.
The proposer receives train records only. `tests/optimize.sh` exits 0 and fails when a held-out case id enters a proposer prompt.
`optimize/run.sh --dry-run` completes with a fake `claude` for the episodes and for the proposer.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: bash tests/optimize.sh on the integrated task branch, exit 0 (36 checks), including the hard-score unit checks at 0.80 and 0.81 of the median. 2 executed: same run; rows hold the plan, verifier, cost, baseline median, turns, and the condensed tool trace. 3 executed: same run; PRD_EFFICIENCY_OPTIMIZE_FAULT=heldout bash tests/optimize.sh exits 1. 4 executed: the test runs optimize/run.sh --dry-run and --proposer-smoke with the fake claude, exit 0; no refs/prd-efficiency* remain.

userStories.title: Run the train baseline
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want a baseline on the train split so that the adapter has a per-case cost reference.
acceptanceCriteria: `runs/baseline-train/` holds 40 scored records: 20 train cases, 2 repeats each.
`summary.json` reports the pass rate, the mean cost, the mean turns, and the median cost for each case.
The run cost is within its phase cap.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: summarize.sh baseline-train; 40 latest records scored, 20 cases x 2 repeats, 0 excluded. The first batch lost 8 slots to the account monthly spend limit (claude exited 1 with the limit message); the resume retried them as attempt 2 after the 12:00 reset. 2 executed: summary.json reports pass rate 0.80, mean cost $0.874, median $0.866, mean turns 15.1, and per_case median costs for 20 cases. 3 executed: the run cost $36.34 of the $40 cap, including $1.39 on episodes that the spend limit stopped. Failure classes: real plan defects (1124 g3, 1076 g1 and g2, 1080 g2 task-folder file) and two lexical verifier false positives (1181 g2, 1054 g1 negation line); both classes affect both arms.

userStories.title: Smoke the real proposer
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want one real proposer call on `claude-opus-5-5` before the loop so that the proposer path is proven outside the fake `claude`.
acceptanceCriteria: One proposer call through `optimize/proposer-claude` on 3 train rows returns exit 0 and a patch that SkillOpt parses.
The call costs $2.00 or less, and `proposer-usage.jsonl` records the cost.
The proposer process has no tools and runs from an empty directory, per its recorded command line.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: optimize/run.sh --proposer-smoke, exit 0; one proposer call on train rows 1181, 1086, 1173; SkillOpt parsed and applied 4 edits. 2 executed: runs/proposer-smoke/result.json records cost $0.233 and proposer-usage.jsonl records the call. 3 executed: the recorded command line has --tools '' and cwd_empty true.

userStories.title: Run the optimization loop
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want the SkillOpt loop on the train split so that the loop freezes one candidate.
acceptanceCriteria: The loop stops at 6 candidates or 140 episodes, whichever comes first.
`runs/optimize/candidates.jsonl` holds each candidate with its train `hard` rate, its mean cost, its diff size, and its status.
`runs/optimize/frozen.json` names the candidate with the highest train `hard` rate. A tie goes to the smaller diff.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: optimize/run.sh --detach; SkillOpt ran 6 steps and produced 3 candidates in 60 optimize episodes; steps 4 to 6 skipped with no usable patches because candidate 3 left no failing train row (failure_only). Caps not reached: 3 of 6 candidates, 60 of 140 episodes, about $52 of $150. 2 executed: runs/optimize/candidates.jsonl holds k 1 to 3 with train hard rates 0.25, 0.65, 1.0, mean costs $0.726, $0.653, $0.475, diff sizes, and status accepted. 3 executed: runs/optimize/frozen.json names candidate 3 (12ec980b, refs/prd-efficiency/cand-3). Each candidate SKILL.md is copied to runs/optimize/candidates/. Train observation: candidate 3 median substance 10 paths and 19 criteria against 15 and 30 for the baseline.

userStories.title: Evaluate on the held-out split
userStories.description: As the operator, I want a paired held-out comparison so that the verdict follows the decision rule of issue #1197.
acceptanceCriteria: `runs/heldout/` holds scored records for 12 held-out cases, for both arms, at the repeat count from `noise.md`.
The baseline arm and the candidate arm of each case and repeat run in the same batch, in alternating order.
`summarize.sh heldout --paired` reports each condition of the decision rule as true or false.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: summarize.sh heldout --paired; 72 latest records scored, 12 cases x 2 arms x 3 repeats, 0 excluded. 2 reasoned: run-batch.sh ran both arms in one batch and alternated the arm order for each slot; the account spend limit stopped 13 slots (1061 baseline r3, all of 1092 and 1168), and the resume batch retried them with both arms of 1092 and 1168 again in one batch. 3 executed: summary.json paired.decision reports ratio_le_max true, upper_lt_max true, pass_rate_guard true, no_new_failure_class true, substance_guard false, verdict no-success.

userStories.title: Report the result
userStories.description: As the operator, I want a results file and an issue comment so that the next focus follows from evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: `results.md` states the verdict, the held-out metrics for each arm, the paired ratio and its interval, the guard results, the total cost, and the candidate diff.
`git diff --stat origin/development -- .agro/evals/experiments/skillopt-ste .agro/evals/experiments/prd-grounding .agro/evals/experiments/git-conventions` prints nothing.
A comment on issue #1197 reports the verdict and the total cost.
